This individual was a '''superintendent''' at a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Sundari Mandalorian school/Legends|school]] in the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorians]]' [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]].

==Biography==
The man got involved with a [[Moogan/Legends|Moogan]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] ring that delivered supplies to [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He felt the [[New Mandalorians|New Mandalorian]] government had given the school too little funds and was promised some of the earnings by the smugglers. Although he admitted to the connection when caught by a task force led by [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], he had no idea the [[Tea/Legends|tea]] he had helped distribute contained [[Poison/Legends|toxins]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Superintendent is voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]], who also voices [[Tee Va/Legends|Tee Va]] in the same episode as well as the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]].<ref name="Corruption Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode305.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Corruption}}</ref>
